design_brief_zh: 主卖点是TSA密码锁便于海关人员快速查验，配合涤纶内衬、双区分隔和X型固定带，讲清“查验便利—内部有序”的购买理由；不使用未提供的安检通过、绝对安全或官方背书表述。PC画布1464×600：左侧文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.1,0.38,0.8]，按标题、支持说明、证据/细节1、证据/细节2自上而下排列；右侧产品区[x,y,w,h]=[0.49,0.08,0.46,0.84]，展示YWJ 13A旅行行李箱三分之四正面角度，箱体闭合并清晰露出TSA锁、铝合金框架和四个防撞角，同时以自然的开箱视角或小型细节画面展示涤纶内衬、双区分隔与X型固定带。移动端1200×900：上方产品/旅行查验场景区[x,y,w,h]=[0.08,0.05,0.84,0.53]，底部文案区[x,y,w,h]=[0.05,0.64,0.9,0.31]，重新按标题→支持说明→两条证据排列，保证德语约20%扩展空间。使用低饱和中性色、品牌蓝#01447B与橙色#E5641E作少量结构强调，自然侧光和柔和阴影突出PC/ABS箱体、铝合金边框及四角防护；背景保持欧洲现代旅行摄影风格，画面需与其他A+模块连屏衔接。字体使用Arial、Helvetica或Amazon Ember风格无衬线字体，标题和TSA字样优先清晰；不在图中额外添加价格、尺寸、认证或促销信息。使用随附的YWJ品牌Logo并保持低调一致。四行文案依次对应：标题说明TSA锁，支持说明解释查验便利，细节1展示涤纶内衬和双区，细节2展示X型固定带。
compliance_note_zh: 仅使用已提供的TSA密码锁、便于海关快速查验、涤纶内衬、双区分隔和X型固定带事实；不得暗示海关认可、保证快速通关、绝对安全或任何未提供的认证、测试和性能。画面不得使用竞品商标、虚构评分、促销角标或隐藏关键词。
image_prompt_en: Create a premium Amazon A+ split-panel travel photography composition for the YWJ 13A suitcase, with a seamless visual language for connected modules. PC layout: 1464x600, reserve a clean blank text area on the left at 5% x, 10% y, 38% width, 80% height; place the product on the right at 49% x, 8% y, 46% width, 84% height. Show the suitcase in a three-quarter front angle with its actual vertical-ribbed hard shell, aluminum frame, TSA combination lock, and four protective corners clearly visible. Include a realistic customs-inspection travel context and a subtle open-case detail view showing the polyester lining, two separated compartments, and X-shaped securing straps. Emphasize the practical inspection workflow and organized interior without implying guaranteed clearance or official endorsement. Mobile layout: product and travel scene in the upper 84% x, 5% y, 84% width, 53% height, with a clean blank copy area across the bottom at 5% x, 64% y, 90% width, 31% height. Use low-saturation neutral European travel photography, natural side light, soft shadows, premium blue #01447B and restrained orange #E5641E accents, modern clean background, realistic material textures, and consistent YWJ branding with the supplied logo. Use Arial, Helvetica, or Amazon Ember-style sans-serif typography only if text is added later. Do not render any text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, badges, prices, certifications, or promotional graphics in the image.
